The ServiceNow Administrator plays a central role in the managed services organization as part of the DevOps team, primarily handling user-oriented support activities. The role involves monitoring and handling incidents, performing first-level analysis and troubleshooting, resolving incidents based on provided solution sheets, and coordinating with DevOps Developer teams and interface providers when escalation is required.

The ServiceNow Administrator serves as a single point of contact for end users to raise queries, incidents, and requests through the SHARP ticketing tool. The role also includes knowledge management activities, ticket monitoring, reporting, and participation in a 24/7 shift rotation model.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Incident Management & Support
• Monitor and handle SHARP incident tickets and document results based on knowledge transfer sessions.
• Perform first analysis of incoming incidents.
• Qualify and pre-clarify incidents by understanding user requirements.
• Analyze incidents to determine whether they fall within the provider service scope.
• Categorize, prioritize, and complete missing information related to incidents.
• Route incidents to the responsible resolver group and establish transparency with the DevOps Developer team.
• Resolve support and admin-related incidents based on solution sheets provided by the DevOps Developer team.
• Explain complex incident resolutions in a user-friendly manner.
• Generate and transfer incidents to the next escalation level, including involvement of the DevOps Developer team or interface providers when required.
• Create new incidents for responsible service organizations when issues fall outside the SENSE Application Management service scope and reference them to the initial escalation.
• Communication & Coordination
• Communicate with end users and call openers through written communication and TEAMS calls during analysis and after incident resolution.
• Coordinate effectively in a multi-provider environment.
• Take lead on high-priority incidents when required.
• Ticket Monitoring & Reporting
• Monitor tickets, manage escalations, and perform ticket reporting using the standard functionality of the Siemens Healthineers ticketing tool.
• Knowledge Management
 • Create Knowledge Articles for recurring incidents to improve support efficiency.
• Identify and create End-User Self-help Knowledge Articles for publication in the ITSM Portal.
• Shift & On-call Support
 • Participate in a 24/7 shift rotation model.
• Work during weekends as required.
• Be available for on-call duties and overtime outside regular business hours.

 Required Skills

 • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Excellent communication skills in a multi-provider environment.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Good understanding of ITSM processes, including:
 • Incident Management
• Problem Management
• Knowledge Management

• Ability to explain complex solutions in a user-friendly manner.
• Leadership and management soft skills to handle high-priority incidents.
• Scripting experience is an advantage.

 Experience

 • Minimum 3+ years of experience working in a ServiceNow ITSM environment.

 Certifications & Training - The following certifications and trainings should be completed prior to onboarding:

 • ServiceNow Fundamentals
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) – Preferred
• ITIL Foundation V4 – Preferred

• Extensive ServiceNow Testing experience across ITSM, ITOM, and HRSD, including complex workflows, integrations, and custom applications.
• Hands-on expertise in designing robust ATF suites for regression, smoke, and integration testing, with a focus on maintainability and scalability.
• Proven track record in large-scale ServiceNow implementations, migrations, or upgrades (e.g., testing during version upgrades, patching, and module rollouts).
• Familiarity with ITOM components such as Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and their testing considerations (data quality, integrations, and performance).
• Exposure to test management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar) for managing test cases, execution, and defect tracking in ServiceNow projects.
• Design and execute ServiceNow test strategies across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD and other modules, covering functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios.
• Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and test data based on business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications for ServiceNow implementations and enhancements.
• Perform hands-on ServiceNow Testing for configurations, customizations, workflows, catalog items, integrations, and UI policies to ensure quality and compliance with requirements.
• Utilize Automated Test Framework (ATF) to design, build, execute, and maintain automated test suites, improving coverage and reducing manual effort.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, business analysts, process owners, and project managers to clarify requirements, identify gaps, and validate solutions.
• Analyze test results and defects, perform root cause analysis, and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution and revalidation of fixes.
• Ensure test traceability from requirements to test cases and defects, maintaining clear documentation and test evidence in appropriate tools and repositories.
• Support release and deployment activities by performing smoke, sanity, and regression testing in sub-prod and production-like environments.
• Contribute to testing standards and best practices for ServiceNow projects, including reusable test assets, templates, and checklists.
• Mentor junior team members (where applicable) in ServiceNow Testing approaches, ATF usage, and quality assurance practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

About The Role

 We are seeking a ServiceNow ITOM Platform Engineer with hands-on cloud experience to build, operate, and continuously improve our ITOM capabilities in ServiceNow. This role is responsible for Discovery, CMDB data quality, and Service Mapping across hybrid on-prem and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).

 What You'll Do

 • Design, implement, and operate ServiceNow IT operations management capabilities with a focus on discovery, configuration data quality, and service mapping across on‑premises and cloud environments.
• Build and maintain reliable discovery architecture by managing mid‑server design, credential handling, network zoning, performance tuning, and monitoring.
• Improve trust in configuration data by applying identification and reconciliation best practices, enforcing data quality standards, and aligning configuration and service models to common service data structures.
• Create, validate, and optimise service maps that accurately represent application and infrastructure dependencies and support operational decision‑making.
• Integrate cloud platforms into ServiceNow by ensuring cloud resources are modelled, normalised, and governed according to ownership, environment, and cost standards.
• Develop automation and integrations that reduce manual effort and improve platform reliability using workflows, scripting, and application programming interfaces.

 What You'll Bring

 • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow engineering experience with a strong focus on ITOM. 
• Proven experience with Discovery, CMDB, and MID Server deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
• Hands-on cloud engineering experience with one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including Understanding of cloud resource models (accounts/subscriptions, regions, VMs, load balancers, managed services, ephemerals, auto-scaling) Azure policy configuration & reporting 
• Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, network connectivity, credentials, and data quality issues. 
• Experience with ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript), including Business Rules, Script Includes, and Scheduled Jobs. 
• Service Mapping experience, including pattern-based methodologies and dependency validation. 
• IRE knowledge (identification rules, reconciliation behavior, duplicate prevention/troubleshooting). 
• Integration experience with Integration Hub (OOB/custom spokes), scripted REST, and OAuth flows. 
• Ability to work across platform, cloud, and infrastructure teams to model services accurately and improve operational visibility.

 About Us

 At Codvo, we build scalable, future-ready digital platforms that drive real business impact. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and ownership—where designers work closely with product and engineering teams to deliver high-quality, user-centered experiences. If you thrive in complex product environments and care deeply about design quality from concept to production, this role is for you.

Role Summary

Codvo is building a ServiceNow delivery pod for a telecommunications operator that runs a 24/7/365 Network Operations Center (NOC) across North America. The operator is moving off a legacy ITSM platform onto ServiceNow.

The first goal is closed-loop ticketing: bring live network health into the ticket during a customer call, correlate alarms from several sources to the right troubleshooting guide, and trigger log collection and corrective actions in place of manual follow-up. Network KPI data lives in a lakehouse that agents pull by hand today, and a large catalog of network KPIs has no clear mapping to specific faults. You help build the platform and the integrations that close that loop.

What You Will Build

 • Scoped application components: tables, business rules, script includes, UI policies, and Agent/UI Builder workspaces for NOC agents.
• Flow Designer flows and IntegrationHub spokes that pull network KPI reports into tickets and push updates back.
• Event Management rules that turn raw alarms into correlated alerts and incidents.
• Catalog items, knowledge articles, and intake-quality checks that catch incomplete tickets before acceptance.
• ATF tests for your own work, with a clean handoff into code review.

 Responsibilities

 • Pick up stories from the Tech Lead, build to the agreed patterns, and get them through review.
• Write integrations against documented contracts: REST, MID Server, and IntegrationHub.
• Test your own work with ATF, fix what review finds, and keep update sets and commits clean.
• Help the migration: move ticket data and workflows onto ServiceNow.

First 90 Days

 • Shipped your first scoped-app feature and one integration through review.
• Comfortable with pod patterns, update sets, and ATF.
• Contributing to the closed-loop build at the team pace.

Must Have

 • 3+ years in software development with hands-on ServiceNow build experience.
• Server-side and client-side JavaScript on ServiceNow: Glide APIs, business rules, and script includes.
• Flow Designer, and at least one shipped REST or IntegrationHub integration.
• Comfortable in a scoped application and with update sets or source control.

Nice to Have

 • Event Management, CMDB, or Service Mapping exposure.
• UI Builder and Workspace experience.
• Telecom or NOC domain familiarity.
• Any ServiceNow AI exposure: Now Assist or Virtual Agent.

Certifications

 Required: 

 • CSA — Certified System Administrator
• CAD — Certified Application Developer (or in progress)

 Preferred: 

 • Any CIS specialty
• Now Assist / AI micro-certifications

 About Us

 At Codvo, we build scalable, future-ready digital platforms that drive real business impact. Role Summary

Lead a pod of three ServiceNow developers building the NOC platform. Turn the architecture into working scoped apps, flows, and integrations — and stay hands-on in the code.

Codvo is building a ServiceNow delivery pod for a telecommunications operator that runs a 24/7/365 Network Operations Center (NOC) across North America. The operator is moving off a legacy ITSM platform onto ServiceNow.

The first goal is closed-loop ticketing: bring live network health into the ticket during a customer call, correlate alarms from several sources to the right troubleshooting guide, and trigger log collection and corrective actions in place of manual follow-up. Network KPI data lives in a lakehouse that agents pull by hand today, and a large catalog of network KPIs has no clear mapping to specific faults. You help build the platform and the integrations that close that loop.

What You Will Lead

 • Break the architecture into stories for closed-loop ticketing, alarm correlation, and migration work; sequence them across the increment.
• Build and review scoped applications, Flow Designer flows, business rules, and IntegrationHub spokes connecting ServiceNow to the lakehouse, contact center, and NeIO agent layer.
• Own Event Management configuration: event rules, alert correlation, and mapping from network KPIs and alarm sources to troubleshooting guides and incidents.
• Stand up ticket-quality checks: required-data validation, intake quality scoring, and auto-augmentation with site health.
• Stand up Performance Analytics dashboards for real-time NOC views: operational health, KPI trends, and SLA posture.
• Set the developer workflow: branching, update-set or pipeline strategy, code review, ATF tests, and definition of done.

 Responsibilities

 • Run the day-to-day of a three-developer pod: assign work, unblock the team, review every change, and keep delivery on the PI plan.
• Stay hands-on — write the hard integrations and the reference patterns the team copies.
• Work with the Architect on design and with customer data engineering leads on integration contracts.
• Hold the quality bar through code review and ATF coverage; flag scope and timeline risk early.

First 90 Days

 • A working developer pipeline: branching, review, and ATF in place.
• First closed-loop story shipped to a test instance and demoed.
• Reference patterns documented for the pod to reuse.

Must Have

 • 7+ years building software; 4+ years hands-on ServiceNow development.
• Strong scripting: server-side and client-side JavaScript, Glide APIs, and scoped application development.
• Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST integrations, and inbound/outbound event handling.
• ITOM Event Management configuration, or equivalent alarm and event pipeline work.
• Has led a small team and owned code review and delivery quality.

Nice to Have

 • Remedy-to-ServiceNow migration experience.
• Contact center platform integration (NICE InContact, Genesys, or Amazon Connect).
• Databricks or REST-based data lakehouse integration experience.
• ServiceNow AI: AI Agents, Now Assist, NASK skills, and grounding.
• Integrating ServiceNow flows with external AI services via REST and webhooks.
• ServiceNow Virtual Agent and NLU configuration for self-service deflection.
• ServiceNow Knowledge Management module configuration.
• Telecom or NOC domain; hands-on CMDB and CSDM.

 About The Role

 We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Application Engineer with the ability to direct our ITAM and ITSM landscape, with platform-wide architecture accountability. This is a senior, hands-on role: you will own the end-to-end design for IT Asset Management (HAM Pro and SAM Pro) and ITSM, ensure both are architected cleanly against our CMDB and CSDM, and govern how the platform evolves across integrations, performance, and operability.

You will be the technical steward who signs off solution designs, holds standards across the team, and represents the platform's interests when working with vendors, business stakeholders, and other engineering teams.

 What You Will Own

 ITAM architecture and delivery

 You will own the ITAM domain on the ServiceNow platform — This includes asset lifecycle design from planning through disposal, software licence position and entitlement modelling across major publishers (Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, VMware), contract and reclamation workflows, normalisation and reconciliation at scale, and audit-defence-ready compliance posture. You will design and operate Service Graph Connectors (SCCM, Intune, Jamf, Tanium, Entra, AWS, and similar) to feed ITAM and CMDB with trustworthy data.

 ITSM architecture and platform stewardship

 You will architect ITSM end-to-end — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge — ensuring processes are aligned to ITIL practice but pragmatic to the business. You will rationalise customisations toward out-of-the-box where appropriate, set standards for how the ITSM team builds and operates, and ensure CMDB/CSDM alignment so ITSM, ITOM, and ITAM share a coherent data model.

 Platform administration and governance

 You will set and enforce platform governance — scoping policy, naming conventions, update set hygiene, technical debt management, upgrade strategy, and performance standards. You will participate in or lead the Technical Governance Board, review and sign off solution designs from internal teams and vendors, and own the platform health and upgrade roadmap.

 Integrations

 You will architect integrations to and from ServiceNow — REST and SOAP web services, Integration Hub spokes, OAuth and SAML flows, MID Server design, Service Graph Connectors, and event-driven patterns. You will define integration standards, error-handling and retry patterns, and the credentialing and secrets-management approach.

 Technical mentorship

 You will provide technical mentorship to mid-level and junior engineers in the team, review designs and code, and represent the platform's voice in vendor engagements — including reviewing vendor-produced BRDs and signing off vendor solution designs from a platform-fit and operability perspective.

 Day-to-day Responsibilities

• Drive CMDB and CSDM health — class model, identification and reconciliation rules, discovery patterns, data quality KPIs.
• Set up and operate Service Graph Connectors and other ITAM data sources; troubleshoot data quality and reconciliation issues end-to-end.
• Design and implement complex integrations using REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, MID Server, OAuth, and SAML.
• Provide technical sign-off on solution designs — internal and vendor-produced — for ITAM, ITSM, and platform-impacting work.
• Define and enforce technical governance: scoped applications, naming, update sets, code review standards, upgrade readiness.
• Mentor engineers, run technical deep-dives, and uplift the team's capability in ServiceNow.
• Stay current on the ServiceNow roadmap, especially AI features (NowAssist, AI Control Tower) and emerging ITAM capabilities, and bring practical adoption proposals.

 Must-have Skills And Experience

 • 10+ years overall IT experience, with 7+ years on ServiceNow in delivery and architecture roles.
• Deep, hands-on expertise in ITAM — both HAM and SAM — including lifecycle design, licence position management, reconciliation at scale, and audit-defence experience.
• Strong ITSM architecture experience — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge — and the maturity to push back on customisation where OOB is right.
• Solid CMDB and CSDM architecture experience — class model, identification rules, IRE behaviour, data quality governance.
• Proven integrations experience — REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, OAuth, SAML, MID Server, Service Graph Connectors (SCCM/Intune/Jamf/Tanium/Entra/AWS or equivalents).
• Strong platform administration depth — scopes, update sets, ACLs, performance tuning, upgrade strategy.
• Hands-on coding in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Scripted REST APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes.
• Demonstrated ability to write and review solution design documents and sign off as a technical authority.
• Strong stakeholder communication and the credibility to challenge vendors and business stakeholders constructively.

 Certifications

 Nice to have

Job Description: ServiceNow Business Analyst (CSM & Logistics) 
 Overview: 
 Seeking a skilled and detail-oriented ServiceNow Business Analyst with a strong specialization in the Customer Service Management (CSM) module to join our enterprise applications team. In this role, you will act as the vital bridge between our global logistics operations and our technical ServiceNow development team.
 

 Primary focus will be optimizing and scaling Case Management capabilities.
 

 Key Responsibilities 
 

 1. Requirement Gathering & Process Mapping 
 • Collaborate with logistics stakeholders (Customer Success, Freight Forwarding, Warehouse Operations, and Account Managers) to understand their operational pain points.
• Deconstruct complex, manual logistics processes and map them into streamlined ServiceNow CSM workflows.
• Define and document clear, actionable User Stories , Functional Requirement Documents (FRD) , and Acceptance Criteria using Agile methodologies.

 

 2. ServiceNow CSM & Case Management Optimization 
 • Design and optimize Case Management architectures, including Case Types , Assignment Rules , Escalation Paths , and SLA/OLA configurations tailored to time-sensitive logistics metrics.
• Configure and maximize the utilization of CSM features such as Major Issue Management, Omni-channel routing (Email, Chat, Portal), and advanced Knowledge Management for customer self-service.
• Collaborate with architects to integrate ServiceNow CSM with core logistics systems (e.g., Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and global tracking APIs).

 

 3. Testing, Training, & Deployment 
 • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, including creating test scripts, coordinating with business testers, and managing defect triaging.
• Develop comprehensive training materials, user guides, and documentation for logistics agents and external customers utilizing the ServiceNow Service Portal.
• Support change management efforts to ensure smooth adoption of new platform features and releases (e.g., Xanadu/Washington DC).

 

 Qualifications & Skills 
 

 Educational & Professional Experience 
 • Experience: 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 2+ years dedicated exclusively to the ServiceNow CSM module.
• Industry Knowledge: Proven experience working within the Logistics, Supply Chain, Maritime, or Freight Forwarding industries is highly preferred.
• Methodology: Strong proficiency in Agile/Scrum frameworks and tools like Jira or ServiceNow Agile 2.0.

 

 Technical & Functional Skills 
 Crucial Competencies: 
 • Deep understanding of the ServiceNow CSM data model (Accounts, Contacts, Consumers, Install Base, and Assets).
• Hands-on experience designing specialized Case Management workflows (e.g., claims processing, delivery failures, billing disputes).
• Familiarity with ServiceNow Performance Analytics and Reporting to track operational KPIs (e.g., First Contact Resolution, Mean Time to Resolve).

 Soft Skills 
 • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—ability to translate "logistics speak" into technical requirements and vice versa.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with an eye for UI/UX best practices in portal design.

 Preferred Certifications 
 

 Ideal candidate will possess one or more of the following credentials:
 • Certified ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM) 
• Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI-PBA

Experience level –5+ yrs. of ServiceNow Development experience
 Mandatory and good to have skill set 
 • Mandatory – ServiceNow ITSM development experience. Hands on experience on CCPA, Service Catalog development, Portal, Reports and Dashboards
• Good to have skills – Should have worked on Service Catalog, PPM, HRSD, IRM, VR, CMDB. Hands-on experience on Performance analytics
• Should have worked on /understand PowerShell scripts, create, and maintain ATFs

 **Keywords –**ServiceNow Development ITSM, HRSD, VR, CMDB etc.
 **Roles and responsibility –**Design, build and test ServiceNow enhancement stories. Provide software coding and customization including, but not limited to screen tailoring, workflow administration, report setup, data imports, integration, scripting, third party software integrations, and custom application development

We are seeking Architects to join Staples Enterprise Architecture team focused on enabling business outcomes and shaping the organization’s digital future. This team plays a strategic role addressing opportunities across people, processes, and technology and mitigating them through mature architecture, analysis, and design practices integrated into the enterprise delivery lifecycle. 

A key initiative is the development of an Enterprise Architecture Platform that consolidates IT data across the organization—spanning strategy, execution, and maintenance—to uncover redundancies, optimize operations, and inform technology planning and decision-making at every level.

We are looking for highly skilled candidate who is technically adept yet strategically minded capable of driving EA platform creation and leveraging insights to influence enterprise decisions.

Key Responsibilities
Application Portfolio Management
Implement integration from several data sources into EA platform to enable end-to-end portfolio management process. This includs data collection, curation and integration into the Abacus EA tool. Collaborate with vendors who publish EOL data sets and EA platform vendors to define metamodels and working models. Drive key use cases such as technology obsolescence and end-of-life analysis, technology and application rationalization, cost/value assessments, risk and compliance reviews and dependency mapping to inform strategic roadmaps and lifecycle management.

Solution & Technical Architecture 
Socialize and review architecture standards, conduct design reviews, and ensure compliance with enterprise guidelines.

Architecture Patterns & Design Practices
Demonstrate practical mastery of modern architecture and design patterns across web, dataintensive and AI/ML applications including layered/hexagonal/clean architecture, microservices and eventdriven design, APIfirst (REST/GraphQL), serverless, containers & orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), CQRS and saga for distributed transactions, streaming & batch data (Kafka/Spark), data lakehouse/data mesh principles, cache & performance patterns (CDN, edge, async), resilience & reliability (circuit breaker, retry, backoff), observability (logging, tracing, metrics), security & compliance by design (zero trust, OAuth/OIDC, secrets, encryption) and AI/ML engineering (feature stores, model training/serving, MLOps, monitoring, responsible AI). Apply these patterns to design scalable, secure, costeffective solutions and coach engineering teams on their effective use.

TOGAF & ArchiMate Knowledge (Nice-to-Have)
Familiarity with TOGAF (framework, ADM, governance) and ArchiMate notation for modeling strategy, business, application, technology, and motivation layers. Ability to read/create architecture views and metamodels, ensure traceability from capabilities to solutions, and improve communication with stakeholders.

Operational & Financial Data Proficiency (Nice to Have)
Demonstrate strong hands on capability working with CMDB/asset inventories, finance/cost data (including chargebacks, licensing/contracts), and application usage/telemetry metrics (APM, logs, traces) to drive fact based portfolio insights, rationalization, and risk management. Additionally, be fluent with vendor/SLA data, technology lifecycle signals (EOL/EOS), cloud tagging & cost allocation (FinOps), and business capability mappings to ensure decisions are traceable from spend and usage to outcomes and roadmap priorities.

Engineering Partnership
Build strong relationships with engineering teams to enhance design-to-implementation synergy and improve delivery quality. Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and deliver measurable outcomes.

Requirements

Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; Master’s preferred.
6 to 10 years of combined Software engineering and architecture experience with good understanding of Solution Architecture and or Technical Architecture principles.
Technical Expertise
Be able to do hands on coding and scripting where required to conduct Proof of concepts and proof of technology
Strong understanding of architecture frameworks and tools
Experience in retail domain highly desirable.
Proficiency in technology selection, integration patterns, and governance models.
Soft Skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Collaborative mindset with ability to influence across organizational levels.

The Enterprise Architect (Application Portfolio Management) is responsible for the strategic, data-driven, and AI-enabled management of Olympus’ global application portfolio (~1,700+ applications and growing). The role ensures full visibility, governance, and optimization of applications across on-premise, cloud, and SaaS environments.
 

 This position focuses on aligning the application landscape with business strategy, driving application modernization, rationalization, and lifecycle management, while enabling data-driven decision-making through automation, analytics, and AI.
 

 The role establishes a single source of truth for the application landscape by integrating tools such as LeanIX and ServiceNow, enabling continuous discovery, high data quality, and real-time insights.
 Additionally, this role supports AI-enabled applications, automation initiatives, and digital transformation programs (e.g., RISE with SAP) by ensuring architecture alignment, risk visibility, and governance compliance.
 

 The Enterprise Architect collaborates across business and IT to improve efficiency, reduce redundancy, manage technology risks, and support strategic transformation initiatives.
 

 Main Responsibilities
 

 • Develop and implement a modern, data-driven Application Portfolio Management (APM) strategy aligned with business and IT objectives.
• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for application lifecycle, ownership, and data quality.
• Define and enforce architecture guardrails, standards, and policies.
• Maintain a single source of truth for the application portfolio using tools such as LeanIX and ServiceNow.
• Drive automated discovery and synchronization of application data via integrations, APIs, and surveys.
• Ensure high-quality, complete, and up-to-date application metadata (ownership, lifecycle, cost, risk, interfaces, hosting model).
• Conduct portfolio assessments (business fit, technical fit, cost, risk, lifecycle status)
• Identify opportunities for rationalization, consolidation, modernization, and decommissioning.
• Apply frameworks such as TIME (Tolerate, Invest, Migrate, Eliminate) for portfolio decision-making.

• Evaluate the architectural impact of emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and intelligent platforms.
• Enable use of AI-driven insights and analytics for portfolio decision-making.
• Promote automation of APM processes, reporting, and data quality management.
• Collaborate with Business and IT stakeholders (Application Owners, SMEs, architects).
• Drive adoption of APM processes and tools across regions
• Support transformation programs such as RISE with SAP and integrated toolchains
• Enable application roadmaps aligned to business capabilities and transformation initiatives
• Define and track KPIs (data quality, lifecycle coverage, redundancy, risk, modernization progress).

 Make a real impact on business success!

• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a supportive and successful team.

 Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply today!
